purpose: identify the smallest missing evidence for pre-execution selection value
common_candidate_pool: same 18 builder-seed cells plus bare, with source hashes recorded

tasks.held_out: new task/database block not used by prior W1 or Phase-II analyses

per_candidate.baseline: same bare execution block for every candidate

answers.repeat_validation: whether development-selected repair and harm signs persist on independent execution
answers.policy_utility: whether a frozen selector improves held-out net utility over bare and the full-pool best-fixed comparator
answers.cost: whether any gain survives logical/API calls, tokens, latency and monetary cost

stop_rules: do not resend preserved unknown/unclosed requests
do not claim stable complementarity if baseline or repeat blocks are incomplete
do not run without explicit budget and authorization
